images.caption: The SS Red Oak Victory in 2013, after repair and refurbishment in 2011. At the time of this image, she is the last operational Victory ship in the world. Used extensively during World War II for transport of various goods, the Victory class was a faster and longer range successor to the earlier Liberty class, with about the same cargo capacity.
